overview: RemeDi introduces a self-reflective remasking mechanism for mask-based Diffusion Language Models, utilizing a dual-stream architecture (TPS and UPS) trained via Remask SFT and Remask RL to iteratively identify and revise low-confidence tokens during generation.

modules.name: Dual-Stream Transformer Architecture
modules.description: Implementation of the dual-stream model structure, comprising the Token Prediction Stream (TPS) for predicting token distributions and the Unmasking Policy Stream (UPS) for predicting per-token confidence scores. Includes the bi-directional feature sharing mechanism with bi-residual connections and zero-initialized bridges between the two streams.

modules.name: Noise Schedule & SFT Input Construction
modules.description: Construction of the noisy input sequences for Remask SFT. Implements the dual noise strategy: applying mask noise with a specific ratio and injecting incorrect tokens (random replacement) with another ratio. Enforces the constraint ensuring the total number of mask tokens monotonically decreases across diffusion steps.

modules.name: Remask SFT Objective & Loss Calculation
modules.description: Calculation of the joint training objective for the supervised fine-tuning stage. Includes the standard diffusion loss on masked tokens and the Binary Cross-Entropy (BCE) loss for the UPS stream, where labels are assigned based on token types: positive for clean tokens, negative for incorrect tokens, and soft labels (predicted probability) for masked tokens.

modules.name: Reinforcement Learning Policy Definition
modules.description: Definition of the joint policy for Remask RL, which factorizes the transition probability into the unmasking policy and the token prediction policy. Implements the Plackett-Luce model for sampling the subset of positions to unmask based on UPS confidence scores, and the categorical sampling for token values at the selected masked positions.

modules.name: Remask RL Optimization (GRPO)
modules.description: Implementation of the outcome-based reinforcement learning pipeline using the Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) algorithm. Manages the generation of multiple trajectories, computes the advantage values based on trajectory rewards, and updates the dual-stream model parameters by backpropagating through the joint policy probabilities.

modules.name: Variable-Length Block-Wise Generation
modules.description: Implementation of the inference pipeline supporting variable-length generation. Manages the iterative appending of mask token blocks to the context, applying block-wise causal masking in attention layers, and terminating the generation process upon producing an end-of-sequence token.

modules.name: Self-Reflective Remasking Inference Loop
modules.description: Core inference logic for the reverse diffusion process. At each step, it obtains confidence scores from the UPS, selects tokens for unmasking, and uniquely allows previously unmasked tokens with low confidence to be remasked and deferred to later steps. Ensures the linear schedule controlling the total number of unmasked tokens is maintained.

modules.name: Data Processing & Multi-Domain Formatting
modules.description: Preprocessing and formatting of the diverse training and evaluation datasets spanning mathematics, code, general conversation, and science domains. Handles data deduplication, length filtering, and the alignment of prompt-response structures required for both SFT and RL stages.

modules.name: RL Reward Functions & Verification
modules.description: Implementation of the dual reward signals for reinforcement learning. Includes verifiable reward computation for math (mathematical expression equivalence) and code (test case pass rates), as well as the integration of a model-based reward for evaluating human preference alignment and instruction following.

modules.name: Core Evaluation Metrics Implementation
modules.description: Calculation of all evaluation metrics used in the paper, including exact match and accuracy for mathematical reasoning, pass@1 rates for code generation benchmarks, and specific scoring logic for instruction following (IFEval), commonsense reasoning (ARC-C), and preference evaluation (AlpacaEval win rate).

modules.name: Benchmark Evaluation Pipelines
modules.description: Execution scripts for running the zero-shot evaluation on specific benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH, HumanEval, MBPP, GPQA, Hellaswag, ARC-C, IFEval, AlpacaEval). Manages the generation configurations (e.g., generation length, block size, sampling strategy) specific to each dataset and applies classifier-free guidance where applicable.

modules.name: Ablation Study & Component Analysis
modules.description: Framework for conducting controlled ablation experiments, including comparisons between Vanilla SFT and Remask SFT, Remask RL vs. other RL baselines (e.g., LLaDOU RL), predictor-corrector vs. learned remask policy, and the removal of specific architectural components like bi-residual connections or zero-init bridges.

modules.name: Generation Visualization & Confidence Mapping
modules.description: Tools for visualizing the step-by-step generation process, highlighting remasked tokens, newly unmasked tokens, and remaining masks. Includes the mapping of per-token confidence scores to color intensities and the analysis of remasking frequencies across different tasks and difficulty levels to demonstrate self-reflective behaviors like merging, splitting, and inserting tokens.

modules.name: Experiment Tracking & Configuration Management
modules.description: Infrastructure for managing training configurations (learning rates, optimizer states, gradient thresholds), handling checkpoint persistence for the dual-stream model, and tracking experiment metrics (rewards, validation accuracies) across the warm-up, Remask SFT, and Remask RL stages.
